title: Vitamin Sea | 5BR Rental on Seacrest Beach | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Vitamin Sea is a signature 5BR Seacrest Beach home with a carriage house and resort pool access. This luxury 30A rental sleeps 14 by Royal Destinations. Book today!
description_expanded: Description: Vitamin Sea at Seacrest by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 87 Seacrest Drive, Seacrest, FL 32413 Details: Your dream 30A escape awaits at Vitamin Sea at Seacrest! Gather the entire family (and even the extended one) at Vitamin Sea at Seacrest, a spacious coastal retreat designed for unforgettable memories. With professional décor, luxury finishes, and a resort-worthy pool deck and outdoor lounge, every moment here invites you to relax and savor the beauty of beach life. This home goes beyond the ordinary, featuring a whole-home water purification system that delivers fresh, purified water to every faucet and chlorine-free steam to every shower- a rare touch of wellness luxury. Located just a short stroll from the beach access at the end of Seacrest Drive, you’ll be perfectly positioned near the best of 30A’s east end, from Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach to The Big Chill and 30Avenue’s dining and boutiques. Whether it’s a multi-family getaway, a couples’ retreat, or a celebration by the sea, Vitamin Sea at Seacrest is more than a vacation home, it’s your 30A sanctuary. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach Access: 350 Feet - Parking Spaces: 6 - Garage - Elevator - 1 Gbps (gigabits per second) Fast Internet Streaming - Whole Home Water Purification System (purified water from all faucets including bathrooms and showers) -Private Heated Pool *Pool heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. -Pet Friendly with approval *Additional Fee Applicable $350 each (pre-tax) *Please contact Reservations for approval prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 22 7 Bedrooms/5 Baths/2 Half Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: (En Suite) King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Kitchen / Dining Area Seats 20 -Living Room -Half Bath -Laundry Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 (Grande Suite 1): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) Twin Sleeper Sofa -Bedroom 3: (En Suite) King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 4: Open Bunk Room (1) Twin/Twin Bunk and (2) Twin Beds -Access to Carriage House Third Floor: -Bedroom 5 (Grande Suite 2): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) Twin Sleeper Sofa Carriage House: -Bedroom 6: Queen Bed with Shared Bath -Bedroom 7: Bunk Loft (4) Twin Beds with Shared Bath -Queen Sleeper Sofa Tower: -Half Bath Amenities Include: -8 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
